newsitem.title: USA: AFTER THE BELL - Nordstrom trades lower.
newsitem.headline: AFTER THE BELL - Nordstrom trades lower.

text.p: Nordstrom Inc fell a point to 35 in after-hours trading on Thursday after releasing its fourth-quarter results in the late afternoon, traders said.
The Seattle-based company reported net income of $0.53 per share for the quarter, down from $0.67 per share for the same period the year before.
Nordstrom shares had closed at 36 on the Nasdaq exchange, which is even with where they opened Thursday.
The New York Stock Exchange said session one volume was 96,200, compared to 80,900 on Wednesday. Session two volume was 1,856,000, while on Wednesday it was 1,561,000.
